title: Tax, deposit and hidden lines on an estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: An estimate has a few settings beyond its lines: the tax rate, a deposit, and what the client sees.

steps.caption: Open E-1999
steps.narration: Open the estimate. This one is a draft for Imani Brewster, in Dallas.

steps.caption: Tax %
steps.narration: Tax percent is the rate for this one estimate. You can type a different rate here.

steps.caption: Deposit
steps.narration: Deposit is what you ask for up front. Type the amount in dollars.

steps.caption: Two boxes under every line
steps.narration: Further down, every line has two boxes underneath.

steps.caption: Taxable
steps.narration: Untick Taxable, and that line is left out of the tax.

steps.caption: Hidden from client
steps.narration: Tick Hidden from client to keep a line off the client's copy.

steps.caption: Totals update
steps.narration: The tax and the total update as you go.

steps.caption: Marked hidden
steps.narration: On your copy, that line is now marked hidden.

steps.caption: Deposit due
steps.narration: And the deposit shows under the total.

steps.caption: The client's lines
steps.narration: Your client sees two lines. The hidden one is not listed, but its price is still in the total.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Close the preview to come back to the estimate.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Every estimate is under Estimates, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to set tax and a deposit on an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Fine-tune an estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM: set its tax rate, ask for a deposit, mark a line as not taxable, and hide a line from the client's copy. Then preview what the client sees. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
